verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਰ ਚੋਰ ਓਰ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਨ ਆਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਕਲ ਭੂਤ ਹੇਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jaar chor or herat na aaeh kouoo chor jaar jaanat sakal bhoot herahee ||

en.bdb: Just as in normal circumstances no one pays attention to a thief or a paramour, but once it becomes known, they look like demons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਮੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪੈਸਤ ਸੰਕਾਤ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhin samai aavaa gavan bhavan bikhai taahee gireh paisat sa(n)kaat hai a(n)dher hee ||

en.bdb: Just as one keeps going in and out of a house freely, but at night during darkness one feels scared of entering the same house.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ  ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਭਇਆਨ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਹ ਤ੍ਰਾਹ ਟੇਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dharamaatamaa kau dhekheeaai dharamarai  paapee kau bhiaan jam traeh traeh Terahee ||

en.bdb: Just as the Yamraj (angel of death) is the King of righteousness for a righteous person at the time of his death, but the same Yamraj is a demon for a sinner who. appears to him as a demon and he shouts for help for his safety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਪਨ ਰੂਪ  ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਫੇਰ ਹੀ ॥੬੪੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise niravair satigur dharapan roop  taiso hee dhikhaavai mukh jaise jaise fer hee ||643||

en.bdb: Similarly the True Guru is sans enmity, with a heart as clear and clean as a mirror. He wishes ill of no one. But with whatever type of face one turns towards Him, he sees the True Guru in the same form (For righteous people, He is love and for sinners he is a monster).  (643)
